stem: In a recipe 3 eggs are used to make 45 cookies. Which table shows the relationship between the number of eggs used and the number of cookies made?

options.label: F
options.text:

Number of Cookies 270 405 540 675

options.label: H
options.text:

Number of Cookies 15 15 15 15

options.label: G
options.text:

Number of Cookies 90 135 180 225

options.label: J

Number of Cookies 6 9 12 15
